paper_title: NExtLong Toward Effective Long-Context Training without Long Documents
caption: NExtLong reduces the model's dependence on proximal text. We calculated the degree of dependence on proximal text (the last third of the text) for different methods when completing the LongQA task. It can be observed that NExtLong significantly reduces the model's dependence on proximal text.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the attention weight associated with short-dependence attention for various methods. The horizontal axis displays the method names – Standard, ICLM, KNN, Quest, and NextLong – arranged in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the “Attention Weight,” ranging from 0.80 to 0.88, with evenly spaced tick labels and a linear scale. Each bar corresponds to a specific method and is colored light blue. The bar for “Standard” reaches a height of approximately 0.86, while the bar for “NextLong” reaches a height of approximately 0.82.  The bars for ICLM, KNN, and Quest have heights of approximately 0.85, 0.86, and 0.84, respectively. All bars are presented without visual emphasis, and the chart is not sorted in any particular order.
